name: Ryuudou Issei
source:
Ryuudou Issei is the Student Body President of Homurabara Highschool, and a close friend of [url=/c15]Emiya Shirou[/url]. Issei often asks Shirou to fix broken equipment for the Student Body to try and reduce save money on the school's bill. Issei and Shirou often have lunch together in the Student Body's office where they talk about what ever comes to mind.

His father is the head priest of Ryuudouji Temple, and his brother was a classmate of [url=/c43]Taiga[/url] and Neko-san. He dislikes [url=/c34]Toosaka Rin[/url] and seems to have some sort of fear of females, although he seems to be unusually at ease around [url=/c33]Saber[/url].

[Edited from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Fate/stay_night_characters]Wikipedia[/url]]
